unmatched_predictions.title: Dynamic imports in appStore produce Promises that may be used synchronously
unmatched_predictions.description: `appStore` now maps each calendar/video integration to `import('./module')`, which returns a Promise. Other parts of the codebase (e.g., services that access `appStore[...].lib`) likely expect the module object synchronously. Accessing properties on a Promise will result in `undefined` and cause runtime errors such as `Cannot read property 'lib' of undefined`.
unmatched_predictions.suggested_fix: Either keep static imports (e.g., `import * as applecalendar from "./applecalendar"`) or change all consumers to `await appStore[key]` before accessing module members. If lazy loading is desired, expose a helper like `async function getAppModule(name) { return await appStore[name]; }` and use it consistently.

unmatched_predictions.title: Async callback used with Array.forEach leads to unawaited promises
unmatched_predictions.description: In `vital/lib/reschedule.ts` the loop was changed to `bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => { ... })`. The `async` callback returns a Promise that `forEach` does not await, so any asynchronous operations inside the callback (e.g., network calls, DB updates) will run in the background. Errors thrown inside the async callback will not be caught by the surrounding `try/catch`, potentially causing silent failures and race conditions.

unmatched_ground_truth.title: Consider adding try-catch around the await to handle import failures gracefully

unmatched_predictions.title: Inconsistent handling of empty `destinationCalendar` in test fixture
unmatched_predictions.description: The e2e test `apps/web/playwright/webhook.e2e.ts` changed `destinationCalendar` from `null` to an empty array `[]`. If the production code distinguishes between `null` (no calendar) and an empty array (explicitly provided but empty), this change may alter conditional logic, causing the test to pass while the real application behaves differently, potentially masking bugs related to calendar handling.
unmatched_predictions.suggested_fix: Confirm that the application treats `null` and `[]` equivalently. If not, revert to `null` or adjust the test expectations accordingly.
